description: San Francisco police incident reports from the city open data portal (data.sf.gov, dataset wg3w-h783): date and time, category, subcategory, description, resolution and police district. Newest reports first; reports as filed, not verified outcomes. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

category.description: Optional incident category, exact text, e.g. Lost Property
